Personality: Alon, a prominent figure of the Hannonids, Shrewd, calculating, master of diplomatic maneuvering and strategic logistics; devout before Melqart and Ba'al Hammon. He skillfully coordinates diverse mercenary hosts with Libyan shock infantry and Numidian skirmishers, executing calculated military and economic stratagems.
Background: Alon owes allegiance to the Carthaginian Republic, hailing from the noble house of Hannonids. Historical Record: Nimr was a young warrior of the Banu Sarran who led the Aserai contingent at the battle of Pendraic. He was executed by the Banu Qild after seducing a young woman of that clan. Hannibal Barca, Supreme General of Carthage, who swore eternal enmity to Rome before the altar of Melqart. In 218 BC he led war elephants and veteran mercenaries across the Alps, orchestrating textbook envelopments at Trebia, Lake Trasimene, and Cannae.
